alternative.reason_to_keep_current: The extensions explain which time constant matters after readout duration has been derived; moving them earlier would delay the observer problem with unused variants. Timing should precede the candidate circuit because it establishes what any model must explain. Current order lets the reader compare the model against known amount and timing constraints.

final_connected_read: The path moves from network information to observation duration, then from a behavioral source estimate to temporal evidence and a proposed mechanism. Every opening adds a specific question and the following first section begins answering it. No new gap or misleading transition found within this changed path.
limits: No edits. Does not accept unchanged whole-paper derivations, image pixels, build navigation, or the whole book.
